hints.title: Strictly Positive Sliding Window
hints.text: All elements in nums are strictly positive integers. Expanding the right boundary monotonically increases the product, while advancing left decreases it.

hints.title: Dynamic Window Contraction
hints.text: Maintain running product. While product is at least k and left <= right, divide product by nums[left] and increment left.

hints.title: Subarray Counting per Right Endpoint
hints.text: Every valid window [left, right] contributes exactly right - left + 1 contiguous subarrays ending at index right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs takes quadratic O(N^2) time and risks integer product overflow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window processes each element at most twice (once for right, once for left) in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle edge cases like k <= 1 immediately returning 0.
